args.summary:
Model built and all L1/L2/L3 checks passed.

Structure: Cast-in-place continuous prestressed concrete single-cell box girder, 4 spans 35+45+45+35 m (bearing centre-lines), modelled as a 2D spine beam on piers (structure.system = continuous_on_piers) with elastic beam-column elements.

Section (cast_box, integrated exactly): A = 6.712 m², I = 4.498 m⁴ (B_top 12.5, B_bot 6.5, h 2.2, t_top 0.25, t_bot 0.22, t_web 0.45, cantilever root 0.5 → tip 0.2). C50 concrete, Ec = 34500 MPa (JTG 3362-2018 3.1.5), γ = 26.0 kN/m³ (JTG D60-2015 4.2.1), self-weight only: w = 174.512 kN/m, m = 17.789 t/m.

Supports: Abutments 0 & 4 and Piers 1 & 3 = PTFE sliding laminated elastomeric bearings (2 per line), modelled with vertical spring Kv and longitudinal free (Kh = 0). Pier 2 = plain elastomeric fixed bearing, longitudinal spring Kh = 13090.9 kN/m. Bearing S and Kv computed from JTG 3362-2018 8.7 using the manufacturer's Ge = 1.2 MPa. Piers: twin circular columns Ø1.8 m, C40 (Ec = 32500 MPa), A = 5.0894 m², I = 1.0306 m⁴, heights 26/10/29 m, fixed at base.

Live load: Highway Class I, one-way, carriageway 11.5 m → 3 design lanes, ξ = 0.78, qk = 10.5 kN/m, Pk = 330/350/350/330 kN (spans 35/45/45/35 m).

Analysis results: first three vertical frequencies 2.660 / 3.612 / 4.787 Hz; impact factor μ = 0.1572 (from f1 = 2.660 Hz, JTG D60-2015 4.3.2). Self-weight support reactions 2266 / 7701 / 7988 / 7699 / 2267 kN; self-weight mid-span moments 12934–15109 kN·m and support moments −27535 to −30593 kN·m. Lane-load max positive moment 11539 kN·m, max negative moment −9597 kN·m.
